controls.title: Enable ADB
controls.desc: ADB (Android Debug Bridge) allows connecting to your device over USB or over the network. See https://docs.comma.ai/how-to/connect-to-comma for more info.

controls.title: Enable SSH
controls.desc: Enable SSH access to your device

controls.title: SSH Keys
controls.desc: Add your GitHub username to enable SSH access. It will fetch your public keys from GitHub.

controls.title: Joystick Debug Mode
controls.desc: Enable joystick debug mode for testing

controls.title: Longitudinal Maneuver Mode
controls.desc: Enable longitudinal maneuver mode for testing

controls.title: openpilot Longitudinal Control (Alpha)
controls.desc:
WARNING: openpilot longitudinal control is in alpha for this car and will disable Automatic Emergency Braking (AEB).

On this car, sunnypilot defaults to the car's built-in ACC instead of openpilot's longitudinal control. Enable this to switch to openpilot longitudinal control. Enabling Experimental mode is recommended when enabling openpilot longitudinal control alpha.

allConditionsTrue.reason: Requires alpha longitudinal to be available

controls.title: Show Advanced Controls
controls.desc:
Toggle visibility of advanced sunnypilot controls.
This only toggles the visibility of the controls; it does not toggle the actual control enabled/disabled state.

controls.title: Enable GitHub runner service
controls.desc: Enables or disables the github runner service.

controls.title: Enable Copyparty service
controls.desc: Copyparty is a very capable file server, you can use it to download your routes, view your logs and even make some edits on some files from your browser. Requires you to connect to your comma locally via it's IP.

controls.title: Copyparty Password
controls.desc: Set a password to secure access to your Copyparty file server. Leave empty for no password protection. Reboot required to apply changes.

controls.title: Enable Quickboot Mode
controls.desc:
When toggled on, this creates a prebuilt file to allow accelerated boot times. When toggled off, it immediately removes the prebuilt file so compilation of locally edited cpp files can be made.

To edit C++ files locally on device, you MUST first turn off this toggle so the changes can recompile.

descriptions.needs_disable_updates:
Quickboot mode requires updates to be disabled.
Enable 'Disable Updates' in the Software panel first.
descriptions.enabled:
When toggled on, this creates a prebuilt file to allow accelerated boot times. When toggled off, it immediately removes the prebuilt file so compilation of locally edited cpp files can be made.

To edit C++ files locally on device, you MUST first turn off this toggle so the changes can recompile.

allConditionsTrue.reason: Requires DisableUpdates in the Software panel

controls.desc: Check device health: processes, disk space, memory usage, recent crashes, and critical files. View comprehensive status report.

controls.title: Fix Device Issues
controls.desc: Automatically fix common device issues: duplicate manager processes, stale overlay locks, and verify critical files. Safe to run anytime - only fixes detected problems.
controls.confirm_text: This will check for and fix: duplicate manager processes, stale locks, and missing files. Continue?

controls.title: Test Force Update (Dry Run)
controls.desc: TEST MODE: Simulates the force update process without making any changes. Verifies internet connectivity, branch availability, and all checks. Safe to run - no modifications will be made.

controls.title: Force Update to bp-5.0-beta
controls.desc: WARNING: Clones a fresh copy of bp-5.0-beta, verifies integrity, then replaces /data/openpilot. Uses bulletproof cloning with automatic rollback on failure. Timeout: 15 minutes. Requires reboot after completion.
controls.confirm_text:
This will force update to bp-5.0-beta by:
• Cloning fresh copy to temporary directory
• Verifying branch, commit hash, and critical files
• Replacing /data/openpilot (with automatic rollback on errors)
• Fixing permissions

AGNOS Update: If your device requires an AGNOS update, it will automatically download and install after the first reboot (may take 5-10 minutes).

Timeout: Operation will timeout after 15 minutes.

Continue?

actionButtons.confirm_text:
The update is complete. Reboot now to apply changes?

Note: If an AGNOS update is required, the device prompt you to install after rebooting (this may take 5-10 minutes).
